name: input
title: Input
description: Styles for text fields, textareas, selects, checkboxes, radios, ranges and file inputs, including validation states.

classes.name: input
classes.description: Apply to <input>, <textarea> or <select>. Checkboxes, radios and ranges get accent colors instead of the box style.

classes.name: input--actor
classes.description: Turns a wrapper into the input box so you can put buttons or text next to a bare inner <input> or <textarea>.

variables.name: --input-accent-color
variables.description: Accent color of checkboxes, radios and ranges.

variables.name: --input-rows
variables.description: Minimum height of a rows="auto" textarea.

variables.name: --input-max-rows
variables.description: Maximum height of a rows="auto" textarea.

attributes.name: rows="auto"
attributes.description: Grows with its content (field-sizing: content) between --input-rows and --input-max-rows. On an input--actor wrapper, put rows="auto" on the wrapper; the inner textarea inherits the sizing.

attributes.name: aria-invalid="true"
attributes.description: Red border, for errors reported by your server.

attributes.name: feedback
attributes.description: Hidden until the input is :user-invalid, then shown. Use it for client-side validation messages.

notes: Invalid fields get a red border only after the user has interacted with them (:user-invalid).
css-zero's Rails-only .field_with_errors hook was replaced by the standard aria-invalid="true" attribute.
